create_base_swarm_task: create a BaseSwarmTask subclass that divides work across swarm workers using a custom distribute method
create_swarm_move: create a SwarmMove task that assigns a move action to all swarm agents simultaneously
create_swarm_build: create a SwarmBuild task that distributes block placement across agents by sorting and partitioning the block list
create_swarm_destroy: create a SwarmDestroy task that partitions a schematic and assigns destroy subtasks to each swarm agent
create_swarm_dig: create a SwarmDig task that divides a digging volume by width across agents and assigns origin and dimensions
